meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会用 hyperframes 命令行工具创建、检查、预览并渲染网页视频项目:初始化项目、跑 lint 和 check、打开预览,经批准后输出 mp4 并验证文件。构建或渲染失败时,也会用它诊断并提交反馈报告。
howto.when: 当任务涉及新建或编辑 HyperFrames 项目、运行 lint/check/预览/渲染,或诊断构建或渲染失败时,Claude 会接管并使用该 CLI。

say.text: 用 hyperframes 新建一个项目,叫 quick-demo。
say.note: 会运行 init 命令创建项目脚手架。

say.text: 跑一遍 check,看看有没有问题。
say.note: check 会先跑 lint,再用浏览器审计页面。

say.text: 打开最终预览,我确认后再用高质量渲染。
say.note: 先展示预览,获批后才输出高清视频。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI to build web-video projects: scaffold, lint, check, preview, then render mp4 after approval and verify output. It also diagnoses build/render failures and submits feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves creating or editing a HyperFrames project, running lint/check/preview/render, or diagnosing build or render failures.

say_en.text: Create a new HyperFrames project called quick-demo.
Run check on this project and report any issues.
say_en.note: Check lints first, then audits the page.

say_en.text: Open the final preview; after I confirm, render in high quality.
